about: The Prayer of Manasseh is a prayer from a king who did many bad things and then said sorry to God.

pages.title: A King Says Sorry
pages.text: King Manasseh did many bad things. He turned people away from God. Then he was captured and put in chains. There, he prayed, "Lord, I have sinned. I am so sorry. Please forgive me." God heard him, forgave him and brought him home.
pages.lesson: It's never too late to say sorry to God.
